Jedi Twilight'' |author=[[Michael Reaves]] |cover artist=[[Glen Orbik]] |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Del Rey]] |early release= |release date=[[June 24]], [[2008]]{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/139649/jedi-twilight-star-wars-legends-coruscant-nights-book-i-by-michael-reaves|text=Jedi Twilight: Star Wars Legends (Coruscant Nights, Book I)}} |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=350 |isbn=9780345477507 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=[[19 BBY/Legends|18.8 BBY]]{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=07440#17398526|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-14|time=11:47 AM}} |series=''[[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights]]'' |preceded by="[[The Last One Standing]]" |followed by="[[In His Image]]" }} '''''Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight''''' is the first installment of the [[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights|''Coruscant Nights'' trilogy]] by [[Michael Reaves]]. It starts [[19 BBY/Legends|three months]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], and was released [[June 24]], [[2008]]. ''Jedi Twilight'' has some crossovers and references to ''[[Evasive Action: Prey]]'' by [[Paul Ens]], as the two were developed at the same time. The novel was completed and edited as of [[April]] [[2007]],{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=04500#16459298|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2007-04-03|time=1:58 PM}} but was not released for another year.
